title: Pawn-pair accumulator cache
hypothesis: Caching PP_3Wide pawn-pair accumulator contributions across NNUE refreshes can reduce repeated pair-feature recomputation while preserving identical evaluation semantics, improving CPU efficiency and potentially time-control strength.
feature: NNUE refresh-cache optimization based on Stockfish PR #7149. It adds a small pawn-keyed cache for PP feature accumulations and incrementally updates the cached entry when pawn structure changes. This does not add new relational features; it accelerates the PP_3Wide features already present in the September 2026 Stockfish baseline.

efficiency_screen.caveat: Five very short depth-8 samples on a hosted runner are noisy and order-sensitive; this result is retained as a caution, not as a definitive efficiency rejection.

confirmation.failure: Pinned upstream patch no longer applies cleanly to current FayE main: git apply --check reports patch failed at src/nnue_feature_transformer.h:220.
confirmation.decision: Do not spend more compute or adapt the optimization onto a moving parent after the negative local efficiency screen. Mark no-promotion and move to a different mechanism.

promotion_rule: Do not merge from the 400-game screen. Promote only after a clean fresh paired confirmation provides positive evidence and later validation remains reproducible.
notes: The 400-game strength screen was mildly positive but inconclusive, while the local NPS microbenchmark was negative. The subsequent confirmation could not reproduce the pinned candidate patch on current main. Given the weak strength signal, negative local efficiency signal, and moving-parent applicability failure, FAYE-0003 is closed as no-promotion rather than spending further games adapting this optimization.
